title: Military helicopters following researchers at the crash site
place_text: Aztec crash site, Hart Canyon, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Uh Bill claimed that a couple times at the crash site as he was leaving, he was followed by helicopters, military helicopters. And that actually happened to us once when we were putting the plaque in.

plain: In the 1980s, the researcher Bill Steinman is said to have been followed by military helicopters a couple of times as he left Hart Canyon, near Aztec, New Mexico, where a saucer carrying alien bodies is said to have crashed. Scott Ramsey, who has investigated the Aztec case, tells Michels what Steinman claimed, and says the same thing happened to his own group once while they were putting in a plaque at the site. To Ramsey it suggests the military was still watching the place decades later.
